rule_text: Emergency services do not require prior authorization and are covered regardless of network status.
All requests must include patient demographics, diagnosis, requested procedure, and rendering provider details.
Incomplete or inconsistent submissions may be pended or denied.
Experimental, investigational, or non–FDA-approved treatments are excluded unless an exception is approved.
Routine diagnostic imaging may be auto-approved based on risk thresholds.
Medical necessity review is streamlined for low-risk procedures.
Limited out-of-network exceptions may be granted with approval.
All oncology treatments require prior authorization.
Peer-to-peer clinical review is mandatory for initial and continuation requests.
Treatment plans must align with nationally recognized guidelines.
Experimental oncology therapies are excluded unless exception approval is granted.
